'''Joce''' was a [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Joce fought alongside Masters [[Rubatin]] and [[Injaye]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. When they encountered the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], Joce and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fought against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], but were all defeated.
